outcome: Mode of birth (caesarean section, normal vaginal delivery)
cohort: The study included 1769 admitted pregnant females aged 20 years and above reporting for antenatal screening at Combined Military Hospital Hyderabad, Sindh Pakistan.
finding: The study found that 7.299% of screened pregnant females were positive for serum antibodies for hepatitis B and C, with anti-hepatitis C virus (76.7%) being more frequent than HbsAg (23.3%) among the seropositive cases.
mod_finding: Among the 129 seropositive females, 62% delivered by caesarean section and 38% had normal vaginal delivery.
